# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Modern UWP drawing controls**

## Highlights

Modern .NET UWP apps gain CPU and ANGLE-backed GPU drawing controls for the in-box Windows XAML stack. The new UWP integration targets .NET 10 and remains separate from WinUI. It does not restore legacy uap10.0 support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Modern .NET UWP support** — SkiaSharp.Views.UWP targets net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0 with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies ANGLE and native integration for win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64, reusing the core Win32 Skia and HarfBuzz binaries. This is not legacy uap10.0 support or a Store-certification claim. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))

## API Surface

- **CPU and GPU XAML controls** — Use SKXamlCanvas for CPU drawing and SKSwapChainPanel for ANGLE-backed GPU drawing in SkiaSharp.Views.UWP. PaintSurface callbacks receive control-managed surfaces: CPU surfaces are disposed after the callback, while GPU resources are released when the context is destroyed. The documented sample workflow requires Visual Studio 2026 MSBuild and deployment. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))
